2608.31128.title: DIASENTINEL: An Auditable Multi-Agent System for Guideline-Grounded Diabetes Risk Screening
2608.31128.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) offer promising clinical decision support but remain vulnerable to hallucinated facts, unsupported recommendations, and citation errors. We present DIASENTINEL, a fully on-premise multi-agent system for one-year type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) risk screening and guideline-grounded report generation from electronic health records (EHRs). The system integrates calibrated risk prediction, deterministic clinical signal extraction, Reciprocal Rank Fusion over American Diabetes Association (ADA) guidelines, and a hybrid verification layer combining rule-based checks with LLM entailment. The demonstration provides a real-time batch-screening dashboard and an interactive patient report interface with cited recommendations, verification results, and raw EHR comparison. DIASENTINEL demonstrates a practical framework for reliable, auditable, and privacy-preserving LLM-based clinical decision support.
2608.31128.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）提供了有前景的臨床決策支持，但仍然容易受到虛構事實、缺乏支持的建議和引用錯誤的影響。<lb/>我們提出了DIASENTINEL，這是一個完全本地的多代理系統，用於一年期2型糖尿病（T2DM）風險篩查和基於指導方針的報告生成，資料來源於電子健康記錄（EHRs）。<lb/>該系統整合了經過校準的風險預測、確定性臨床信號提取、基於美國糖尿病協會（ADA）指導方針的互惠排名融合，以及結合基於規則的檢查和LLM推理的混合驗證層。<lb/>該演示提供了一個實時批量篩查儀表板和一個互動式患者報告介面，包含引用的建議、驗證結果和原始EHR比較。<lb/>DIASENTINEL展示了一個可靠、可審計且保護隱私的基於LLM的臨床決策支持的實用框架。
